# EdgeIQ Labs
> Cybersecurity monitoring and managed VPS hosting for small businesses.

EdgeIQ Labs provides affordable security tools, compliance automation, and managed infrastructure for SMBs that can't afford $5K/month security firms. Built by pentesters, not marketers.

## Core Services
- **Managed VPS Hosting**: Linux containers on dedicated Dell PowerEdge hardware with Wazuh monitoring, weekly patching, and full root SSH. From $4/mo. https://edgeiqlabs.com/vps/
- **Compliance Shield**: HIPAA compliance monitoring for small healthcare practices. Audit-ready in 30 days. From $299/mo. https://edgeiqlabs.com/compliance-shield/
- **EdgeIQ Pulse**: Weekly website uptime and security monitoring with plain-English email digests. Free for 1 domain. https://edgeiqlabs.com/pulse/
- **PhishSim**: Employee phishing simulation and cybersecurity awareness training platform. https://phishsim.edgeiqlabs.com/
- **Security Scanners**: 25+ free client-side tools for SSL, DMARC, DNS, headers, subdomains, CVEs, and more. https://edgeiqlabs.com/tools/
